passages.text: Pharaoh said to Jacob, “How many are the days of the years of your life?” Jacob said to Pharaoh, “The days of the years of my pilgrimage are one hundred thirty years. Few and evil have been the days of the years of my life, and they have not attained to the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.”
passages.note: Old age looking back on a hard life

passages.text: Israel said to Joseph, “I didn’t think I would see your face, and behold, God has let me see your offspring also.”
passages.note: Joy beyond hope after long loss
